The '''Eastern Campaigns''' were Vesperan imperial campaigns fought from 1720 to 1750. The extracted Vesperan source describes them as a phase in which the [[Vesperan Empire]] established control over large portions of the eastern continent, including territories later associated with [[Empire of Khalindar|Khalindar]] and [[Volgastan Baathist Republic|Volgastan]].

== Imperial Expansion ==

The campaigns formed part of Vespera's early expansion after the [[Imperial Proclamation of 1710]]. They involved the conquest of local kingdoms, the creation of imperial administration, and the extension of Vesperan influence into eastern trade and military corridors.

== Legacy ==

The Eastern Campaigns are important because later Khalari and Khalindarian states inherited political, military, and administrative pressures from older Vesperan expansion. By the twentieth century, those legacies intersected with the [[Avant Great War]], postwar settlement, and regional claims in former imperial zones.

== Source Limits ==

The source gives the date range and broad territorial meaning but not a complete campaign list, battle order, or final borders. This page is a bridge for later Vesperan and Khalari history, not a final military chronicle.
